SELECT s.store_id >= 900 AS pseudo, f.channel_code, f.staff_purchase_flag, count(*) AS line_rows, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS distinct_line_ids, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts, sum(f.net_amount) AS net, min(f.net_amount) AS min_net, sum(CASE WHEN f.net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos, min(f.sale_date) AS d0, max(f.sale_date) AS d1, count(DISTINCT f.sale_date) AS days
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT f.sale_date, count(*) AS line_rows, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dist_ids, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts, count(DISTINCT s.store_id) AS stores, max(f.etl_loaded_at) AS last_load, d.is_trading_day, d.holiday_name
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-01' AND DATE '2026-09-01' AND f.channel_code='ST'
GROUP BY f.sale_date, d.is_trading_day, d.holiday_name ORDER BY 1

WITH fct AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, f.sale_date, f.receipt_id, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag, f.quantity
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND f.channel_id=1 AND s.store_id<900),
a AS (SELECT count(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS rc_all_distinct, count(DISTINCT (store_id, receipt_id, sale_date)) AS rc_by_store_date, sum(net_amount) AS net_all, sum(CASE WHEN NOT staff_purchase_flag THEN net_amount END) AS net_nostaff, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT staff_purchase_flag THEN receipt_id END) AS rc_nostaff, sum(quantity) AS units_all FROM fct),
r AS (SELECT sum(receipts) AS rpt_receipts, sum(net_sales_before_returns) AS rpt_gross_sales, sum(returns_net) AS rpt_returns, sum(units_sold) AS rpt_units FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND store_id<900)
SELECT * FROM a, r

WITH fct AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, s.format, f.sale_date, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.net_amount, f.quantity, f.etl_loaded_at, f.product_key
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND f.channel_id=1 AND s.store_id<900),
rc AS (SELECT store_id, format, receipt_id, sum(net_amount) AS basket, count(*) AS n_lines, count(DISTINCT line_no) AS n_distinct_lines, sum(quantity) AS units FROM fct GROUP BY ALL)
SELECT format, count(*) AS receipts, count(DISTINCT store_id) AS stores, sum(basket) AS net, round(sum(basket)/count(*),2) AS avg_basket, max(basket) AS max_basket, min(basket) AS min_basket, sum(CASE WHEN n_lines<>n_distinct_lines THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS receipts_dup_lineno, max(units) AS max_units, sum(CASE WHEN basket>2000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS big_baskets
FROM rc GROUP BY format ORDER BY format
